This file is for doing data import.

## Import 2 .csv files
```{r}
library("tidyverse")
```

Import our first dataset.

```{r}
litters_df = 
  read.csv(file = "data/FAS_litters.csv")

litters_df = janitor::clean_names(litters_df)
```

Import the second dataset
```{r}
pups_df = 
  read.csv(file = "data/FAS_pups.csv", skip = 3)

pups_df = janitor::clean_names(pups_df)
```


## Look at the data
```{r}
litters_df
pups_df
```

Head or tail
```{r}
head(litters_df, 20)

tail(pups_df, 5)
```

Skimming?
```{r}
skimr::skim(pups_df)
```
